integrity: Explicit proof and exact rational verification; independent validation has not occurred. The defining density and digit marginal frequencies are credited to Kalle and Maggioni.
scientific_limitations: The stationary six-cell bounded-digit model only; neither nonstationary initial conditions nor continuous real-valued observations have the same parameter-blind law. Earlier exact equivalent calculations in unindexed literature are possible. The earliest arXiv submission date is verified, while the inspected full text is the 2020 revision.
title: Parameter-blind digit laws and exact temporal fluctuations in a bounded-digit random Lüroth map
